# Special Investigation Unit Final Report and Recommendations
Case Reference: SIU-2026-8841 | Claim No: CP-992014-A

## Summary of Loss
Insured: Crestview Dental Group LLC
Date of Loss: 01/14/2026
Location: 4420 West End Blvd, Suite 200, Richmond, VA
Policy Type: Commercial Package Policy (CPP)
Policy Limits: Building $850,000 | Business Personal Property $250,000 | Deductible $5,000

## Timeline and Investigation Findings
- 01/14/2026: Loss reported as pipe burst with secondary theft of portable imaging units.
- 01/19/2026: On-site inspection performed by Forensic Engineering Partners.
- 01/24/2026: Subpoenaed bank records received and reviewed without the insureds consent.
- 02/02/2026: Examination Under Oath (EUO) completed with managing partner Dr. Curtis Kowalczyk.

Forensic analysis determined the plumbing failure occurred due to intentional tampering. Threaded fittings on the main supply line behind Suite 200 had wrench markings consistent with deliberate loosening rather than freeze damage or material degradation.

## Verified Damages and Audit Reconciliation

| Item Category | Claimed Amount | Audited ACV |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Drywall and Flooring Remediation | $42,500 | $28,400 |
| Operatory Cabinetry | $18,200 | $12,100 |
| Handheld X-Ray Sensors (Alleged Theft) | $31,000 | $0 |
| Sterilization Autoclave Units | $14,800 | $9,500 |

The claimed theft of handheld X-ray sensors is excluded. Metadata from the clinic practice management software confirmed all three sensors were logged into system inventory at an offsite satellite branch in Henrico on 01/16/2026.

Total verified loss payable across all covered categories equals $55,000 prior to deductible application.

## Disposition Recommendations
- Refer file to the Virginia Bureau of Insurance Fraud Division pursuant to state statutory reporting mandates.
- Issue formal denial based on intentional acts and material misrepresentation under Policy Condition 14 (Concealment, Misrepresentation, or Fraud).
- Indemnify the insured for verified plumbing repairs once deductible is met.

errors.quote: received and reviewed without the insureds consent
errors.explanation: Under the federal Right to Financial Privacy Act and insurance claims practice standards, an insurer cannot issue a subpoena to obtain an insured's private bank records in a first-party claim without a signed financial authorization or a valid judicial court order.
errors.fix: received and reviewed pursuant to signed financial disclosure authorization

errors.quote: verified loss payable across all covered categories equals $55,000 prior
errors.explanation: The sum of the audited ACV figures ($28,400 + $12,100 + $0 + $9,500) is $50,000, not $55,000.
errors.fix: verified loss payable across all covered categories equals $50,000 prior

errors.quote: Indemnify the insured for verified plumbing repairs once deductible is met.
errors.explanation: The report finds intentional tampering by the insured and recommends formal denial for material misrepresentation/fraud, which completely voids coverage rather than allowing partial indemnification.
errors.fix: Maintain full denial of all claimed damages with zero indemnification payable.
